subject: [PATCH v3] mm: bypass swap readahead for zswap

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: reviewer asked about potential regressions with the zswap shrinker enabled and both zswap and disk swap backends present
reviews.raw_body:
Would there be regression with shrinker on, when we have mixed zswap
and disk swap backends?

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch bypasses swap readahead for zswap, an in-memory synchronous backend similar to zram. The current implementation of swap readahead can lead to pointless prefetching of pages, causing increased anon residency and page cache thrashing. By bypassing readahead for zswap, the patch aims to reduce this overhead and improve performance. Measurements show significant gains in build time, zswap-in/out rates, and reduced swap readahead hits. The patch reuses existing code and adds a new helper function to check if a swap entry is synchronous.
